title: The 10-Foot Giant That Was A Fake Of A Fake 🗿
caption:
True story. In 1869 a 10-foot stone giant was "discovered" on a farm. It was a hoax, and then P. T. Barnum made a fake of the fake. 🗿
Would you have paid to see it? 👇
first_comment: Barnum copied a hoax and crowds preferred his fake. Peak America. Would YOU have paid? 🗿👇
